messages:
Maria P: quick one 12 12 - we need to finalize SI claim rules for the HW+marketplace bundle before Friday AMA. do we prefer CRM ownership, product-fit tags, or a hybrid?
Aisha K: hybrid sounds pragmatic. CRM owner should get precedence for named accounts. tags for discovery/open pipeline. add an ACV threshold so SIs don't get spammed.
Tom L: agreed. propose: named & ACV >= 100k -> SI claim. named & <100k -> notify AE + partner queue. anonymous/opportunity-tagged -> tag-based partner queue. keeps SI capacity sane.
Diego R: sketch for routing logic (will push later):
```yaml
# simplified routing rules
if account.is_named and account.acv >= 100000:
  assign: si_claim_queue
elif account.is_named and account.acv < 100000:
  notify: ae_then_partner_queue
elif 'hw_bundle' in account.tags or 'marketplace_qualified' in account.tags:
  assign: partner_marketplace_queue
else:
  assign: growth_partner_queue
```
Priya S: question re: notifications - should marketplace-bot notify #partnerships + #sales when a claim is created, or should we surface to the owning AE/SE first?
Aisha K: marketplace-bot should always tag owning AE/SE if present, and post to #partnerships + @si-oncall for attention. include a 48h claim acceptance SLA and auto-escalate if unclaimed.
Tom L: also implement a recent-contact overlap guard: if AE/SE or SE has contacted primary contact in last 14 days, prefer assigning back to them and ping partner ops with reason.
marketplace-bot: Automated claim created: "Orion Solutions" -> si_claim_queue. claim_id=CLM-4923 :robot_face:
Diego R: i'll add overlap guard + SLA timer in the routing service and open PR: https://git.internal/redwood/si-routing/pull/129 (wip).
Maria P: great. can someone draft a one-pager for the AMA: include rules, SLAs, notif flow, escalation steps, and a short example timeline?
Priya S: i'll draft and share by EOD. will include sample email/snippets for AE/SE outreach and partner ops templates.
Tom L: please add a small FAQ on edge cases (duplicate claims, marketplace reorder, multi-SI interest).
Maria P: thanks team. once PR lands, we'll run a quick dry-run with a handful of accounts next week. :rocket:
